contexts.text: Things that are evil in man are signified by... wolves, etc.

The wolf shall dwell with the lamb (). The lamb = the [inmost] degree of innocence and love; and the wolf = its opposite. AC 3994:3. AC 10132:3. (See SE 2119.) ( = that those in the Lord's Kingdom who are in the good of innocence shall have nothing to fear from the Hells and the evils therefrom. AE 314:3). AE 780:6.
They had been in despair lest the door was shut... Such thought had been infused into them by those called wolves.
The wolf and the lamb shall feed together (). The wolf = those who are against innocence. AE 314:4.
As the wolf, and the lamb, are opposites, the Lord said to the seventy, I send you forth as lambs in the midst of wolves ().

(Benjamin is a) wolf () = the avidity of snatching away and delivering the good; for a wolf = one who seizes and scatters; and, as beasts, in the Word, = cupidities, a wolf = the avidity of seizing. Illustrated... (Thus) by a wolf are signified those who seize; but here, one who snatches from Hell those who have been seized. Explained. AC 6442-6444, Explained.
The Angel... said to those on the left... a wolf will come and carry (you) off.
They become wolves in ferocity.
The man is killed and devoured, as a lamb by a wolf.
Spiritual hypocrites (are seen to) walk like wolves.
Like giving a shepherd's crook to a man-wolf.
Some Societies of Spirits... said that the wolf had wanted to carry them off, but the Lord had snatched them from the wolf... SE 700.
Those called wolves are sometimes permitted to insinuate themselves into Heaven...
But internally they are wolves. SE 3849. LJPost 154.
Where they are swallowed as by a wolf. LJPost 85.
On the Hell of those who are outwardly innocent, but within are evil. - Wolves.

They appeared like great heads of wolves, which gnashed with their teeth; and, wherever they came they made an inspection, and turned [those there] into a kind of luminous yellowish appearance, and then took hold of it with the mouth, and cast it out: it appeared as though they devoured it... Such is what sometimes happens when deceitful Societies have been (formed).

Beware of false prophets, who... inwardly are ravening wolves () = those who teach falsities as if they were truths; but who, when by themselves... think of nothing but themselves and the world, and study to deprive all others of truths.
Their cunning in destroying truths... is signified by their horses are more acute than wolves of the evening (). ( = cunning in deceiving by fallacies. AE 780:8.)
A wolf = the evil that is opposite to innocence, and that endeavours to destroy it.
The wolf of the plains shall lay them waste () = the derivative dominion of evil... destroying the truths and goods of the Church.
Wolves are seen in Hell.
